Useful messages include YES, NO, NOT SURE, SHOW ME, EXPLAIN AGAIN, STOP, BREAK, HURTS, and where it hurts.Copy Field note 09The handoff.Today’s plan is [ ]. Communication routes: [ ]. Give me time and space. Do not assume less speech means less to say.Copy Field note 11Communication repair.I think I missed that. I will not pretend I understood.
